title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Billing of Rental Time
content:
Rental time on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement runs from the checkout time to the return time, or to the conversion date for converted equipment, and it is billed at return from the item's daily rate on the agreement. The class figures named here are those of the rate card.

## Clauses

1. **Period rates.** Where the class offers a four-hour period, the four-hour rate is the class's four-hour percentage of the daily rate. A day is the class's day length in hours. The weekly rate is the class's weekly multiple of the daily rate and the four-week rate is the class's four-week multiple of the daily rate. Each period rate, and the weekend special rate, is rounded to the nearest cent.
2. **Lowest-cost combination.** Where the class bills that way, the time out is billed as the lowest-cost combination of those periods that covers it, with one rental time line per period type used.
3. **Grace.** A return within the class's return grace minutes after the end of a period is not charged for further time; a return later than that moves into the next period.
4. **Weekend special.** Where the class offers it, equipment checked out on a Saturday and returned no later than one hour after store opening on the following Monday is billed the class's weekend multiple of the daily rate instead, when that is lower than the combination.
5. **No refund of unused time; late time.** Unused time inside a billed period is never refunded, and time past the due-back time is billed at the same rates as the rest of the rental.

## Hypothetical worked examples

| Class and daily rate | Out | Back | Billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting, 200.00 | Tuesday 10:00 | Thursday 10:25 | 2 days, 400.00 (25 minutes past the end of the second day, within the 29-minute grace) |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting, 200.00 | Tuesday 10:00 | Thursday 10:35 | 3 days, 600.00 (past the grace, so into a third day) |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting, 200.00 | Monday 08:00 | Saturday 08:00 | 1 week, 700.00 (five days at 1000.00 cost more than one week at 3.50 times the daily rate) |
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools, 40.00 | Saturday 09:00 | Monday, 30 minutes after store opening | weekend special, 60.00 (lower than two days at 80.00) |

## Points of judgement

- *Is part of a day refunded when the renter brings a tool back early?* No; unused time inside a billed period is never refunded.
- *Is time after the due-back time charged at a penalty rate?* No; it is billed at the same rates as the rest of the rental.
